editorial_checks: Iraq's invasion of Kuwait, the medical/food exceptions and Iraq's rejection of earlier oil-sale proposals remain visible.
Oil-for-Food uses Iraqi export earnings; approvals, funding, delivery, national implementation and differentiated regional distribution are distinguished.
The 2002 Goods Review List procedure is not projected across the entire programme. The 2003 FAO/WFP assessment is dated and not treated as an unchanged account of all the 1990s.
No causal child-death total is repeated. Ali/Shah's 2000 survey finding and Dyson/Cetorelli's 2017 critique are attributed and dated, not made into judicial findings or total causal apportionment.
Commodity approval is not an individual damages tribunal; the essay does not claim every domestic route or all public advocacy was absent.
Kadi's designation is an allegation, not a criminal conviction. Judicial annulment is not an all-purpose criminal acquittal or a judgment on his whole life.
The European courts review European implementing acts, not Security Council resolutions; initial-freeze surprise and subsequent effective review are distinguished.
Kadi II's upheld outcome is distinguished from full endorsement of the General Court's reasoning. Evidence, burdens, confidentiality safeguards and one sufficient substantiated ground are retained.
The pre-existing focal-point route, the 2009 Ombudsperson mandate and the strengthened 2011 decision procedure are separately dated.
The 2012 UN delisting precedes the 2013 European judgment. June 2008 Resolution 1822 precedes the September Kadi judgment; no single-case causal theory of all UN reforms is asserted.
Comprehensive and targeted sanctions are not a simple good/bad pair or proof of a single evolutionary chain. No invented witness, family, dialogue or personal motive is added.
